description: Minecraft servers only: search the modpack catalog (CurseForge, Modrinth, FTB, Technic) with search/provider/offset/limit. Pass modpackId to get that modpack's versions (versionId for install_gameserver_modpack) and a RAM hint. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: list_gameserver_modpacks
title: List Minecraft Modpacks
